judgments.reason: The transesophageal echocardiography finding of 'a patent foramen ovale measuring 7.34 mm in width with a continuous, pure right-to-left shunt on colour flow mapping' is quoted literally in the vignette and directly identifies a congenital cardiac defect (patent foramen ovale) as the structural basis for the PAH diagnosis, clinically supporting the etiology modifier.

The span 'The patient was initially acyanotic from 2010 to 2016, but gradually became cyanotic after an episode of severe cough and hemoptysis' appears literally in the vignette. The progression from acyanotic to cyanotic status is clinically consistent with Eisenmenger physiology in congenital heart disease, supporting PAH secondary to congenital heart disease, though it is a less direct structural indicator than M001.
